question: The famous hill station Kodaikanal is situated in the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Palani hills**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Kodaikanal is a famous hill station located in the **Palani hills** of Tamil Nadu, India.
 
• The Palani hills are part of the Western Ghats, a mountain range that runs parallel to the western coast of India.
 
• Kodaikanal is known for its **scenic beauty, pleasant climate, and rich biodiversity**.
 
• The hill station is often referred to as the "Princess of Hill stations" and is a popular tourist destination.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arunachal hills**

 
 
• Located in the northeastern part of India, Arunachal hills are part of the Eastern Himalayas.
 
• They are known for their dense forests, diverse wildlife, and indigenous tribal cultures.
 
• Important towns in Arunachal hills include Itanagar, Tawang, and Ziro.
 
 
 
• **Nilgiri hills**
 
 
• Situated in the western part of Tamil Nadu, the Nilgiri hills are part of the Western Ghats.
 
• They are known for their tea plantations, eucalyptus forests, and cool climate.
 
• Ooty (Udhagamandalam) and Coonoor are popular hill stations in the Nilgiris.
 
 
 
• **Seven hills**
 
 
• The term "Seven hills" often refers to various hill regions around the world, one of the most famous being the seven hills of Rome.
 
• In India, the term can also refer to Tirumala hills in Andhra Pradesh, which are home to the famous Tirupati Temple.
